findings.note: CBS/RotoWire (Oct 14) confirms Jax starts ALCS Game 3, but says he hasn't gone five innings in a start in more than three weeks, so the Rays will need their bullpen for a big part of the game. That limits how many batters he faces.

VSiN says Jax has thrown only two innings since Sept 26 and questions how sharp he'll be on a damp day in Cleveland. It doesn't know how long he can go and expects Cleveland to swing early in counts. Its pick is Rays moneyline +110, not this prop.

MLB.com says Cash expects Jax to be full go after the line drive that hit his back ended his last regular-season start. Over his last five outings Jax struck out 19 in 20 innings, and Cash cited his starter work all season.
